title: Structural MAC and OOF projected-response consistency
caption: The structural MAC matrix compares FEM/COMSOL mode shapes with the independent Timoshenko graph auditor; the close 6–9 cluster is interpreted by subspace metrics, not forced diagonal identity. The OOF matrix measures temporal MAC after projecting forced responses onto fixed FEM/COMSOL modes and does not claim that PIGNO outputs eigenvectors.
evidence_label: historically exposed grouped OOF; not blind or external
